title: Chapter 10 – Vibhūti Yoga (The Yoga of Divine Glories)
subtitle: Yoga of Divine Glories

verses.title: 10.1 bhuya eva maha-baho
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
भूय एव महाबाहो श‍ृणु मे परमं वचः ।
यत्तेऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया ॥ १०-१॥
verses.roman:
śrībhagavānuvāca
bhūya eva mahābāho śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ
yatte'haṃ prīyamāṇāya vakṣyāmi hitakāmyayā 10-1
verses.colloquial:
shrii bhagavaan uvaacha
bhuuya eva mahaa baaho shrinu me paramam vachah
yat te'ham priiyamaanaaya vakshyaami hita kaamyayaa 10-1
verses.translation_reworded: The Blessed Lord said: Listen once more, mighty-armed one, to My supreme teaching. Because I want your good, I will speak it to you, who take joy in hearing Me.

verses.title: 10.2 na me viduh sura-ganah
verses.sanskrit:
न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः ।
अहमादिर्हि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः ॥ १०-२॥
verses.roman:
na me viduḥ suragaṇāḥ prabhavaṃ na maharṣayaḥ
ahamādirhi devānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ 10-2
verses.colloquial:
na me viduh suraganaah prabhavam na maharshayah
aham aadir hi devaanaam maharshiinaam cha sarvashah 10-2
verses.translation_reworded: Neither the gods in heaven nor the great rishis know where I come from, for in every respect I am the origin of all the devas and the rishis.

verses.title: 10.3 yo mamajam anadim
verses.sanskrit:
यो मामजमनादिं च वेत्ति लोकमहेश्वरम् ।
असम्मूढः स मर्त्येषु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥ १०-३॥
verses.roman:
yo māmajamanādiṃ ca vetti lokamaheśvaram
asammūḍhaḥ sa martyeṣu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate 10-3
verses.colloquial:
yo maam ajam anaadim cha vetti loka maheshvaram
asammuudhah sa martyeshu sarva paapaih pramuchyate 10-3
verses.translation_reworded: Whoever among mortals knows Me as unborn and without beginning, as the great Lord of the worlds, is free from delusion and released from every sin.

verses.title: 10.4 buddhir jnanam asammohah
verses.sanskrit:
बुद्धिर्ज्ञानमसम्मोहः क्षमा सत्यं दमः शमः ।
सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च ॥ १०-४॥
verses.roman:
buddhirjñānamasammohaḥ kṣamā satyaṃ damaḥ śamaḥ
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhavo'bhāvo bhayaṃ cābhayameva ca 10-4
verses.colloquial:
buddhir jnaanam asammohah kshamaa satyam damah shamah
sukham duhkham bhavah abhaavah bhayam cha abhayam eva cha 10-4
verses.translation_reworded: Intellect, wisdom, freedom from delusion, forgiveness, truth, self-control, calm, happiness, pain, birth and death, fear and fearlessness too, . . .

verses.title: 10.5 ahimsa samata tushtis
verses.sanskrit:
अहिंसा समता तुष्टिस्तपो दानं यशोऽयशः ।
भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः ॥ १०-५॥
verses.roman:
ahiṃsā samatā tuṣṭistapo dānaṃ yaśo'yaśaḥ
bhavanti bhāvā bhūtānāṃ matta eva pṛthagvidhāḥ 10-5
verses.colloquial:
ahimsaa samataa tushtis tapo daanam yasho'yashah
bhavanti bhaavaa bhuutaanaam matta eva prithag vidhaah 10-5
verses.translation_reworded: Non-violence, evenness of mind, contentment, austerity, generosity, fame, and disgrace: all these varied qualities found in beings come from Me alone.

verses.title: 10.6 maharshayah sapta
verses.sanskrit:
महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तथा ।
मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः ॥ १०-६॥
verses.roman:
maharṣayaḥ sapta pūrve catvāro manavastathā
madbhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣāṃ loka imāḥ prajāḥ 10-6
verses.colloquial:
maharshayah sapta puurve chatvaaro manavas tathaa
madbhaavaa maanasaa jaataa yeshaam loka imaah prajaah 10-6
verses.translation_reworded: The seven great rishis, the four ancients before them, and the Manus, who share My powers, were born from My mind. From them have come all the creatures in the world, and by them they are sustained.

verses.title: 10.7 etam vibhutim yogam
verses.sanskrit:
एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः ।
सोऽविकम्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः ॥ १०-७॥
verses.roman:
etāṃ vibhūtiṃ yogaṃ ca mama yo vetti tattvataḥ
so'vikampena yogena yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ 10-7
verses.colloquial:
etaam vibhuutim yogam cha mama yo vetti tattvatah
so'vikampena yogena yujyate naatra samshayah 10-7
verses.translation_reworded: Whoever truly knows these many manifestations of My being (the macrocosm) and this yoga-power of Mine (the microcosm) becomes firmly settled in unshakable yoga. Of this there is no doubt.

verses.title: 10.8 aham sarvasya prabhavo
verses.sanskrit:
अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते ।
इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः ॥ १०-८॥
verses.roman:
ahaṃ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṃ pravartate
iti matvā bhajante māṃ budhā bhāvasamanvitāḥ 10-8
verses.colloquial:
aham sarvasya prabhavo mattah sarvam pravartate
iti matvaa bhajante maam budhaa bhaava samanvitaah 10-8
verses.translation_reworded: I am the origin of everything; from Me all things unfold. Understanding this, the wise, filled with loving awareness, worship Me.

verses.title: 10.9 mach-chitta mad-gata
verses.sanskrit:
मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम् ।
कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च ॥ १०-९॥
verses.roman:
maccittā madgataprāṇā bodhayantaḥ parasparam
kathayantaśca māṃ nityaṃ tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca 10-9
verses.colloquial:
macchittaa madgata praanaa bodhayantah parasparam
kathayantashcha maam nityam tushyanti cha ramanti cha 10-9
verses.translation_reworded: With their minds resting entirely in Me and their senses absorbed in Me, they enlighten one another and speak of Me constantly, and in this they find contentment and joy.

verses.title: 10.10 tesham satata-yuktanam
verses.sanskrit:
तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम् ।
ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते ॥ १०-१०॥
verses.roman:
teṣāṃ satatayuktānāṃ bhajatāṃ prītipūrvakam
dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ taṃ yena māmupayānti te 10-10
verses.colloquial:
teshaam satata yuktaanaam bhajataam priiti puurvakam
dadaami buddhi yogam tam yena maam upayaanti te 10-10
verses.translation_reworded: To those who are always steadfast and worship Me with love, I grant the buddhi yoga by which they reach Me.

verses.title: 10.11 tesham evanukampartham
verses.sanskrit:
तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं तमः ।
नाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता ॥ १०-११॥
verses.roman:
teṣāmevānukampārthamahamajñānajaṃ tamaḥ
nāśayāmyātmabhāvastho jñānadīpena bhāsvatā 10-11
verses.colloquial:
teshaam eva anukampa artham aham ajnaanajam tamah
naashayaami aatma bhaavasthah jnaana diipena bhaasvataa 10-11
verses.translation_reworded: Out of pure compassion for them, I, who live within their hearts, dispel the darkness born of ignorance with the shining lamp of knowledge.

verses.title: 10.12 param brahma param
verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान् ।
पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विभुम् ॥ १०-१२॥
verses.roman:
arjuna uvāca
paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma pavitraṃ paramaṃ bhavān
puruṣaṃ śāśvataṃ divyamādidevamajaṃ vibhum 10-12
verses.colloquial:
arjuna uvaacha
param brahma param dhaama pavitram paramam bhavaan
purusham shaashvatam divyam aadidevam ajam vibhum 10-12
verses.translation_reworded: Arjuna said: You are the supreme Brahman, the supreme dwelling place, the supreme purifier, the eternal and divine Purusha, the God of all gods, unborn and present everywhere.

verses.title: 10.13 ahus tvam rishayah
verses.sanskrit:
आहुस्त्वामृषयः सर्वे देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा ।
असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे ॥ १०-१३॥
verses.roman:
āhustvāmṛṣayaḥ sarve devarṣirnāradastathā
asito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṃ caiva bravīṣi me 10-13
verses.colloquial:
aahus tvaam rishayah sarve devarshir naaradah tathaa
asito devalo vyaasah svayam cha eva braviishi me 10-13
verses.translation_reworded: All the rishis have declared You to be this, as have the deva-rishi Narada, Asita, Devala, and Vyasa; and now You Yourself are telling me the same.

verses.title: 10.14 sarvam etad ritam
verses.sanskrit:
सर्वमेतदृतं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि केशव ।
न हि ते भगवन्व्यक्तिं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः ॥ १०-१४॥
verses.roman:
sarvametadṛtaṃ manye yanmāṃ vadasi keśava
na hi te bhagavanvyaktiṃ vidurdevā na dānavāḥ 10-14
verses.colloquial:
sarvam etad ritam manye yan maam vadasi keshava
na hi te bhagavan vyaktim vidur devaa na daanavaah 10-14
verses.translation_reworded: I accept everything You tell me as true, O Keshava. Truly, Blessed Lord, neither the devas nor the danavas know Your manifestation, Your real identity.

verses.title: 10.15 svayam evatmanatmanam
verses.sanskrit:
स्वयमेवात्मनात्मानं वेत्थ त्वं पुरुषोत्तम ।
भूतभावन भूतेश देवदेव जगत्पते ॥ १०-१५॥
verses.roman:
svayamevātmanātmānaṃ vettha tvaṃ puruṣottama
bhūtabhāvana bhūteśa devadeva jagatpate 10-15
verses.colloquial:
svayam eva aatmanaatmaanam vettha tvam purusha uttama
bhuuta bhaavana bhuutesha deva deva jagat pate 10-15
verses.translation_reworded: Indeed, You alone know Yourself, through Yourself, O Purushottama (supreme Purusha), source of beings, Lord of beings, God of gods, ruler of the world.

verses.title: 10.16 vaktum arhasyasheshena
verses.sanskrit:
वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषेण दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः ।
याभिर्विभूतिभिर्लोकानिमांस्त्वं व्याप्य तिष्ठसि ॥ १०-१६॥
verses.roman:
vaktumarhasyaśeṣeṇa divyā hyātmavibhūtayaḥ
yābhirvibhūtibhirlokānimāṃstvaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhasi 10-16
verses.colloquial:
vaktum arhasi asheshena divyaa hyaatma vibhuutayah
yaabhih vibhuutibhih lokaan imaan tvam vyaapya tishthasi 10-16
verses.translation_reworded: Please tell me fully, holding nothing back, about Your divine glories, the ones by which You pervade and dwell in all these worlds.

verses.title: 10.17 katham vidyam aham
verses.sanskrit:
कथं विद्यामहं योगिंस्त्वां सदा परिचिन्तयन् ।
केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया ॥ १०-१७॥
verses.roman:
kathaṃ vidyāmahaṃ yogiṃstvāṃ sadā paricintayan
keṣu keṣu ca bhāveṣu cintyo'si bhagavanmayā 10-17
verses.colloquial:
katham vidyaam aham yogims tvaam sadaa parichintayan
keshu keshu cha bhaaveshu chintyo'si bhagavan mayaa 10-17
verses.translation_reworded: How am I, meditating on You always, to know You, O Yogin? In which forms and in which things, Blessed Lord, should I think of You?

verses.title: 10.18 vistarenatmano yogam
verses.sanskrit:
विस्तरेणात्मनो योगं विभूतिं च जनार्दन ।
भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि श‍ृण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम् ॥ १०-१८॥
verses.roman:
vistareṇātmano yogaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca janārdana
bhūyaḥ kathaya tṛptirhi śṛṇvato nāsti me'mṛtam 10-18
verses.colloquial:
vistarena aatmanah yogam vibhuutim cha janaardana
bhuuyah kathaya triptih hi shrinvatah naasti me amritam 10-18
verses.translation_reworded: Tell me again and in detail, O Janardana, of Your yoga-power and Your glory that fills all things, for I cannot get enough of hearing Your speech, which is like nectar that gives life.

verses.title: 10.19 hanta te kathayishyami
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः ।
प्राधान्यतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ नास्त्यन्तो विस्तरस्य मे ॥ १०-१९॥
verses.roman:
śrībhagavānuvāca
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi divyā hyātmavibhūtayaḥ
prādhānyataḥ kuruśreṣṭha nāstyanto vistarasya me 10-19
verses.colloquial:
shriibhagavaan uvaacha
hanta te kathayishyaami divyaa hyaatma vibhuutayah
praadhaanyatah kurushreshtha naasti antah vistarasya me 10-19
verses.translation_reworded: The Blessed Lord said: Alas! I will now describe My divine glories to you, the ones that pervade all things, choosing only the chief among them, O best of the Kurus, for there is no end to the details of My extent.

verses.title: 10.20 aham atma gudakesha
verses.sanskrit:
अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः ।
अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च ॥ १०-२०॥
verses.roman:
ahamātmā guḍākeśa sarvabhūtāśayasthitaḥ
ahamādiśca madhyaṃ ca bhūtānāmanta eva ca 10-20
verses.colloquial:
aham aatmaa gudaakesha sarva bhuuta aashaya sthitah
aham aadish cha madhyam cha bhuutaanaam anta eva cha 10-20
verses.translation_reworded: I am the Self, O Gudakesha, seated in the hearts of all beings. I am the beginning, the middle, and the end of all beings as well.

verses.title: 10.21 adityanam aham vishnur
verses.sanskrit:
आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां रविरंशुमान् ।
मरीचिर्मरुतामस्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी ॥ १०-२१॥
verses.roman:
ādityānāmahaṃ viṣṇurjyotiṣāṃ raviraṃśumān
marīcirmarutāmasmi nakṣatrāṇāmahaṃ śaśī 10-21
verses.colloquial:
aadityaanaam aham vishnur jyotishaam ravir amshumaan
mariichir marutaam asmi nakshatraanaam aham shashii 10-21
verses.translation_reworded: Among the twelve Adityas I am Vishnu; among sources of light I am the radiant sun; among the Maruts I am Marichi; among the stars I am the moon.

verses.title: 10.22 vedanam sama-vedo
verses.sanskrit:
वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वासवः ।
इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चास्मि भूतानामस्मि चेतना ॥ १०-२२॥
verses.roman:
vedānāṃ sāmavedo'smi devānāmasmi vāsavaḥ
indriyāṇāṃ manaścāsmi bhūtānāmasmi cetanā 10-22
verses.colloquial:
vedaanaam saamavedah asmi devaanaam asmi vaasavah
indriyaanaam manah cha asmi bhuutaanaam asmi chetanaa 10-22
verses.translation_reworded: Among the Vedas I am the Sama-Veda; among the gods I am Vasava; among the senses I am the mind; and in living beings I am the intelligence.

verses.title: 10.23 rudranam shankarash
verses.sanskrit:
रुद्राणां शङ्करश्चास्मि वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम् ।
वसूनां पावकश्चास्मि मेरुः शिखरिणामहम् ॥ १०-२३॥
verses.roman:
rudrāṇāṃ śaṅkaraścāsmi vitteśo yakṣarakṣasām
vasūnāṃ pāvakaścāsmi meruḥ śikhariṇāmaham 10-23
verses.colloquial:
rudraanaam shankarash cha asmi vittesho yaksha rakshasaam
vasuunaam paavakash cha asmi meruh shikharinaam aham 10-23
verses.translation_reworded: Among the Rudras I am Shankara; among the yakshas and rakshasas I am Kubera, the lord of wealth; among the Vasus I am Pavaka (Agni); and among mountains I am Meru.

verses.title: 10.24 purodhasam cha mukhyam
verses.sanskrit:
पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम् ।
सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः ॥ १०-२४॥
verses.roman:
purodhasāṃ ca mukhyaṃ māṃ viddhi pārtha bṛhaspatim
senānīnāmahaṃ skandaḥ sarasāmasmi sāgaraḥ 10-24
verses.colloquial:
purodhasaam cha mukhyam maam viddhi paartha brihaspatim
senaaniinaam aham skandah sarasaam asmi saagarah 10-24
verses.translation_reworded: Among household priests, O Partha, know Me to be the chief of them, Brihaspati; among commanders of armies I am Skanda; among bodies of water I am the ocean.

verses.title: 10.25 maharshinam bhrigur
verses.sanskrit:
महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्म्येकमक्षरम् ।
यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः ॥ १०-२५॥
verses.roman:
maharṣīṇāṃ bhṛgurahaṃ girāmasmyekamakṣaram
yajñānāṃ japayajño'smi sthāvarāṇāṃ himālayaḥ 10-25
verses.colloquial:
maharshiinaam bhrigur aham giraam asmi ekam aksharam
yajnaanaam japa yajnah asmi sthaavaraanaam himaalayah 10-25
verses.translation_reworded: Among the great rishis I am Bhrigu; among words I am the single syllable Om; among sacrifices I am the sacrifice of silent repetition (japa-yajna); among things that do not move I am the Himalayas.

verses.title: 10.26 ashvatthah sarva-vrikshanam
verses.sanskrit:
अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः ।
गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः ॥ १०-२६॥
verses.roman:
aśvatthaḥ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ
gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilo muniḥ 10-26
verses.colloquial:
ashvatthah sarva vrikshaanaam deva rishiinaam cha naaradah
gandharvaanaam chitra rathah siddhaanaam kapilo munih 10-26
verses.translation_reworded: Among all trees I am the ashwattha tree; among divine rishis, Narada; among gandharvas, Chitraratha; among perfected beings, the muni Kapila.

verses.title: 10.27 uchchaihshravasam
verses.sanskrit:
उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां विद्धि माममृतोद्भवम् ।
ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपम् ॥ १०-२७॥
verses.roman:
uccaiḥśravasamaśvānāṃ viddhi māmamṛtodbhavam
airāvataṃ gajendrāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca narādhipam 10-27
verses.colloquial:
ucchaihshravasam ashvaanaam viddhi maam amritodbhavam
airaavatam gajendraanaam naraanaam cha naraadhipam 10-27
verses.translation_reworded: Among horses know Me as Ucchahi-shravas, born of amrita; among royal elephants, Airavata; and among human beings, the king.

verses.title: 10.28 ayudhanam aham vajram
verses.sanskrit:
आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक् ।
प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः ॥ १०-२८॥
verses.roman:
āyudhānāmahaṃ vajraṃ dhenūnāmasmi kāmadhuk
prajanaścāsmi kandarpaḥ sarpāṇāmasmi vāsukiḥ 10-28
verses.colloquial:
aayudhaanaam aham vajram dhenuunaam asmi kaamadhuk
prajanash cha asmi kandarpah sarpaanaam asmi vaasukih 10-28
verses.translation_reworded: Among weapons I am the thunderbolt; among cows I am Kamadhuk; I am Kandarpa, the cause of offspring; among serpents I am Vasuki.

verses.title: 10.29 anantash chasmi naganam
verses.sanskrit:
अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम् ।
पितॄणामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम् ॥ १०-२९॥
verses.roman:
anantaścāsmi nāgānāṃ varuṇo yādasāmaham
pitṝṇāmaryamā cāsmi yamaḥ saṃyamatāmaham 10-29
verses.colloquial:
anantash cha asmi naagaanaam varuno yaadasaam aham
pitriinaam aryamaa cha asmi yamah samyamataam aham 10-29
verses.translation_reworded: Among the nagas I am Ananta; among the deities of the waters I am Varuna; among the ancestors I am Aryama; and among those who govern I am Yama.

verses.title: 10.30 prahladash chasmi
verses.sanskrit:
प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतामहम् ।
मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम् ॥ १०-३०॥
verses.roman:
prahlādaścāsmi daityānāṃ kālaḥ kalayatāmaham
mṛgāṇāṃ ca mṛgendro'haṃ vainateyaśca pakṣiṇām 10-30
verses.colloquial:
prahlaadash cha asmi daityaanaam kaalah kalayataam aham
mrigaanaam cha mrigendro 'ham vainateyash cha pakshinaam 10-30
verses.translation_reworded: Among the daityas I am Prahlada; among those that measure, I am Time; among animals I am the lion, lord of beasts; and among birds I am Vainateya (Garuda).

verses.title: 10.31 pavanah pavatam asmi
verses.sanskrit:
पवनः पवतामस्मि रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम् ।
झषाणां मकरश्चास्मि स्रोतसामस्मि जाह्नवी ॥ १०-३१॥
verses.roman:
pavanaḥ pavatāmasmi rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāmaham
jhaṣāṇāṃ makaraścāsmi srotasāmasmi jāhnavī 10-31
verses.colloquial:
pavanah pavataam asmi raamah shastra bhritaam aham
jhashaanaam makarash cha asmi srotasaam asmi jaahnavii 10-31
verses.translation_reworded: Among purifiers I am the wind; among those who bear arms I am Rama; among fish I am the shark; among rivers I am the Ganges.

verses.title: 10.32 sarganam adir antash
verses.sanskrit:
सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहमर्जुन ।
अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवदतामहम् ॥ १०-३२॥
verses.roman:
sargāṇāmādirantaśca madhyaṃ caivāhamarjuna
adhyātmavidyā vidyānāṃ vādaḥ pravadatāmaham 10-32
verses.colloquial:
sargaanaam aadir antash cha madhyam cha eva aham arjuna
adhyaatma vidyaa vidyaanaam vaadah pravadataam aham 10-32
verses.translation_reworded: Of all created things, O Arjuna, I am the beginning, the middle, and the end as well. Among sciences I am the science of the Self, and in every debate I am the reasoning.

verses.title: 10.33 aksharanam a-karo
verses.sanskrit:
अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि द्वन्द्वः सामासिकस्य च ।
अहमेवाक्षयः कालो धाताहं विश्वतोमुखः ॥ १०-३३॥
verses.roman:
akṣarāṇāmakāro'smi dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya ca
ahamevākṣayaḥ kālo dhātāhaṃ viśvatomukhaḥ 10-33
verses.colloquial:
aksharaanaam akaarah asmi dvandvah saamaasikasya cha
aham eva akshayah kaalah dhaataa aham vishvato mukhah 10-33
verses.translation_reworded: Among letters I am the letter A; among compound words I am the dual compound (the co-ordinate type). I am indeed inexhaustible, everlasting Time, and I am the dispenser of the fruits of action, whose faces look in every direction.

verses.title: 10.34 mrityuh sarva-harash
verses.sanskrit:
मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम् ।
कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा ॥ १०-३४॥
verses.roman:
mṛtyuḥ sarvaharaścāhamudbhavaśca bhaviṣyatām
kīrtiḥ śrīrvākca nārīṇāṃ smṛtirmedhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā 10-34
verses.colloquial:
mrityuh sarva harash chaaham udbhavash cha bhavishyataam
kiirtih shriir vaak cha naariinaam smritir medhaa dhritih kshamaa 10-34
verses.translation_reworded: I am Death, which swallows everything, and I am the rise of those who are destined to rise. Among feminine qualities I am fame, prosperity, speech, memory, intelligence, steadiness, and forgiveness.

verses.title: 10.35 brihat-sama tatha
verses.sanskrit:
बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम् ।
मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः ॥ १०-३५॥
verses.roman:
bṛhatsāma tathā sāmnāṃ gāyatrī chandasāmaham
māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣo'hamṛtūnāṃ kusumākaraḥ 10-35
verses.colloquial:
brihat saama tathaa saamnaam gaayatrii chandasaam aham
maasaanaam maargashiirsho'ham rituunaam kusumaakarah 10-35
verses.translation_reworded: Among hymns, too, I am the Brihat-saman; among metres I am the Gayatri; among months I am Margashirsha (the part of December-January); among seasons I am spring, the season of flowers.

verses.title: 10.36 dyutam chhalayatam
verses.sanskrit:
द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् ।
जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम् ॥ १०-३६॥
verses.roman:
dyūtaṃ chalayatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham
jayo'smi vyavasāyo'smi sattvaṃ sattvavatāmaham 10-36
verses.colloquial:
dyuutam chalayataam asmi tejas tejasvinaam aham
jayo'smi vyavasaayo'smi sattvam sattvavataam aham 10-36
verses.translation_reworded: I am the gambling of cheats; I am the brilliance of the brilliant; I am victory; I am the effort of those who are determined; I am the goodness in the good.

verses.title: 10.37 vrishninam vasudevo
verses.sanskrit:
वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनञ्जयः ।
मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः ॥ १०-३७॥
verses.roman:
vṛṣṇīnāṃ vāsudevo'smi pāṇḍavānāṃ dhanañjayaḥ
munīnāmapyahaṃ vyāsaḥ kavīnāmuśanā kaviḥ 10-37
verses.colloquial:
vrishniinaam vaasudevo'smi paandavaanaam dhananjayah
muniinaam api aham vyaasah kaviinaam ushanaa kavih 10-37
verses.translation_reworded: Among the Vrishnis I am Vaasudeva; among the Pandavas I am Dhananjaya; among the munis I am Vyasa; and among poets I am Ushana, the great seer.

verses.title: 10.38 dando damayatam asmi
verses.sanskrit:
दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम् ।
मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम् ॥ १०-३८॥
verses.roman:
daṇḍo damayatāmasmi nītirasmi jigīṣatām
maunaṃ caivāsmi guhyānāṃ jñānaṃ jñānavatāmaham 10-38
verses.colloquial:
dando damayataam asmi niitih asmi jigiishataam
maunam cha eva asmi guhyaanaam jnaanam jnaanavataam aham 10-38
verses.translation_reworded: Among those who punish I am the sceptre; among those who seek to win I am statesmanship; among secrets I am silence; and among those who know I am knowledge itself.

verses.title: 10.39 yach chapi sarva-bhutanam
verses.sanskrit:
यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन ।
न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम् ॥ १०-३९॥
verses.roman:
yaccāpi sarvabhūtānāṃ bījaṃ tadahamarjuna
na tadasti vinā yatsyānmayā bhūtaṃ carācaram 10-39
verses.colloquial:
yacchaapi sarva bhuutaanaam biijam tad aham arjuna
na tad asti vinaa yat syaan mayaa bhuutam charaacharam 10-39
verses.translation_reworded: Whatever is the seed of every being, that too am I, O Arjuna. There is no being, moving or unmoving, that can exist apart from Me.

verses.title: 10.40 nanto sti mama divyanam
verses.sanskrit:
नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परन्तप ।
एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया ॥ १०-४०॥
verses.roman:
nānto'sti mama divyānāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ parantapa
eṣa tūddeśataḥ prokto vibhūtervistaro mayā 10-40
verses.colloquial:
naanto'sti mama divyaanaam vibhuutiinaam parantapa
esha tu uddeshatah prokto vibhuuteh vistarah mayaa 10-40
verses.translation_reworded: My divine glories have no end, O Parantapa. What I have given you is only a short account of some of their particulars.

verses.title: 10.41 yad yad vibhutimat
verses.sanskrit:
यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा ।
तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसम्भवम् ॥ १०-४१॥
verses.roman:
yadyadvibhūtimatsattvaṃ śrīmadūrjitameva vā
tattadevāvagaccha tvaṃ mama tejoṃ'śasambhavam 10-41
verses.colloquial:
yad yad vibhuutimat sattvam shriimat uurjitam eva vaa
tat tad eva avagaccha tvam mama tejah amsha sambhavam 10-41
verses.translation_reworded: Whatever in any being is glorious, prosperous, or powerful, know that it springs from a fragment of My splendour.

verses.title: 10.42 atha va bahunaitena
verses.sanskrit:
अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन ।
विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत् ॥ १०-४२॥ 

ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु
ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे
विभूतियोगो नाम दशमोऽध्यायः ॥ १०॥
verses.roman:
athavā bahunaitena kiṃ jñātena tavārjuna
viṣṭabhyāhamidaṃ kṛtsnamekāṃśena sthito jagat  10-42

oṃ tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu
brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde
vibhūtiyogo nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ 10
verses.colloquial:
athavaa bahunaitena kim jnaatena tavaarjuna
vishtabhya aham idam kritsnam ekaamshena sthito jagat

om tat sat iti shriimad bhagavad giitaasu upanishatsu
brahma vidyaayaam yoga shaastre shrii krishna arjuna samvaade
vibhuuti yogo naama dashamo'dhyaayah 10
verses.translation_reworded:
But what use is it to you, Arjuna, to know all these details? With a single fraction of Myself I stand supporting this entire world.

So ends the tenth discourse, called "The Yoga of Divine Glories," in the Upanishads of the glorious Bhagavad Gita, the science of the Eternal, the scripture of Yoga, the dialogue between Sri Krishna and Arjuna.
